title: Captcha Failed (I Am Not A Robot)
style: filter house, 122 bpm, four-on-the-floor kick, classic French house chord stabs, deadpan robotic female chorus vocal saying I am not a robot, click sounds and mouse hover percussion, traffic-light photo shutter samples on the breakdown, big disco filter sweep, comedic but danceable, 336 hz subharmonic anchor under the kick
lyrics:
[Intro — robotic checkbox tone]
(robotic) Please verify you are human…
Select all squares with traffic lights…
Click to continue…

[Verse 1]
I clicked on every traffic light I could see
It failed me twice, then it failed me three
It asked again, this time crosswalks
Then fire hydrants, then storefront talks

[Pre-Drop]
I am the most human person on this whole damn screen
But the box says I'm a bot, I don't know what it's seen

[Drop]
I am not a robot — I am not a robot
Click the squares with the traffic lights spot
I am not a robot — I am not a robot
Three-three-six on the captcha and it still says NOT

[Verse 2]
Select all images containing a bus
The bus is half a pixel, the bus is sus
Is the wheel a bus? Is the road a bus?
My whole identity reduced to a fuss

[Drop]
I am not a robot — I am not a robot
Click the squares with the traffic lights spot
I am not a robot — I am not a robot
Three-three-six on the captcha and it still says NOT

[Outro]
(robotic) Verification successful…
Welcome… human…
(beep)
